verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a stability metric: the proportion of user sessions that are error-free, tracked against configurable stability targets. It also documents release-level views, including filtering the dashboard by release, identifying which release introduced errors, and release annotations on the error-rate timeline. Missing for 10: explicit crash-free users metric, adoption per release, a side-by-side comparison of a canary release against the last stable release, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
